 Avril Lavigne has revealed her baby daughter with a mystery partner on social media, posting “Our Mini Fucking Princess has arrived,” alongside a three-photo set.
 Photographs include a tiny hand clutching two different adult hands, Lavigne holding her little girl, and three pairs of checkered vans on top of a skateboard. No other details have been made public.
 Lavigne was engaged to Mod Sun in 2023 before embarking on a tabloid romance with Tyga, but the “Sk8er Boi” singer has since kept her romantic life private. Last year she helped induct Cyndi Lauper into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame .
